correctness.rationale: The exact reduction t=exp(-2z/p), eta=|1-2/p| transforms the published rotation-radius formula to sinh(eta z)/cosh z. Strictly monotone tanh(eta z)tanh z yields the unique interior maximizer. At epsilon=1-eta, u=exp(-2z), v=u^(1-epsilon) satisfy epsilon=2(u+v)/[(1+u)(1+v)], forcing u~epsilon/4 and z~L/2; second Taylor expansion yields u=(epsilon/4)(1+epsilon(1-L)/2+O(epsilon^2 L^2)) and the two-term value including -epsilon^2(L^2+1)/8. Hilbert-end follows stationary perturbation z=z*+O(eta^2) and the derivative vanishing at z*. Finite high-precision checks of four epsilon values showed residuals on predicted scales; these are not infinite proofs.
